```python
from pyasn1 import univ
from pyasn1.codec.native import decoder

# Define a simple sequence schema
s = univ.Sequence()
s.setComponentByPosition(0, univ.Null())
s.setComponentByPosition(1, univ.OctetString())
s.setComponentByPosition(2, univ.Integer())

# Try to decode a Python dict to ASN.1 sequence
input_data = {'place-holder': None, 'first-name': 'xx', 'age': 33}
result = decoder.decode(input_data, asn1Spec=s)

print("Input:", input_data)
print("Result:", result)
print("Expected length:", 3)
print("Actual length:", len(result))
```

The decoder should produce a sequence with all three fields properly mapped, but instead it appears to be dropping elements or mapping them incorrectly.
